Wikipedia: the multiple bitings “perfected by Callot”

highlight.text: The technique of using multiple bitings of acid on the plate, with different areas "stopped-out", was perfected by Callot. This method allows gradations in the strength of the line, with distant parts of the scene usually lighter.
